answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it may trade, and let that stake decay slowly like a pulse that must be renewed by verifiable work. A newcomer starts in a shared meadow of low-value tasks where mistakes are cheap; only after a history of honest attestations does it earn access to high-value deals. Sybils face a real cost: each identity needs its own stake and its own slow record, so flooding the market means locking up capital across many sable accounts that cannot share one reputation.
